resources.string: Arc read this file and found no picture in it that it can play. Files made for video editing, such as Apple ProRes, are like this. Pick another copy of the title.
The source didn\'t answer
This source\'s server sent no video for %1$d seconds. This comes from the source, not from Arc. Try another source, or try this one again later.
The source\'s server has a fault
This source\'s server answered with an error (%1$d). This comes from the source, not from Arc. Try another source, or try this one again later.
The source blocked this link
This source\'s server refused the link (error %1$d). This comes from the source, not from Arc. Try another source.
This file is gone from the source
The server says this file is no longer there (error %1$d). This comes from the source, not from Arc. Try another source.
This link has expired
The source\'s link has run out (error %1$d). Go back and open the title again for a fresh link, or try another source.
The service is limiting requests
This service is asking Arc to slow down. This comes from the service, not from Arc. Wait a little before trying again, or pick a source from another server.
Arc couldn\'t reach the source
This source\'s server can\'t be reached. If other sources play, that server is down: pick another one. If nothing plays, check the box\'s internet connection.
The provider sent a notice, not the film

Instead of the film, the add-on or Debrid service sent a short notice video. That usually means the file isn\'t ready yet, your account has reached a limit, or a sign-in has expired. This comes from the add-on, not from Arc. Check the add-on or your Debrid account, or try another source.
This link isn\'t a video
The server sent something that isn\'t a video, often a web page or an archive. This comes from the source, not from Arc. Try another source.
This box can\'t play this file
This file is %1$s, more than this box\'s video chip can play. This comes from the box, not from Arc. Pick another copy of the title, such as 4K or 1080p.
This file\'s video format is more than this box\'s video chip can play. This comes from the box, not from Arc. Pick another copy of the title, such as 4K or 1080p.
